status: Saturday done — Sunday games start 7:30 AM (Detroit time)
note: Ranks are MHR’s Nov 11 ratings and move live as results come in. Game times are local to the rink. Many rinks stream on LiveBarn.

summary: Challenger Cup after Saturday morning: Toronto Jr Canadiens (CAN) are 3-0 with three shutouts (3-0 Top Gun, 6-0 Windy City, 6-0 St. Louis). Little Caesars (#3, 97.66) are 3-0 and Nashville (#8, 96.52) is 3-0. Team Illinois (#6, 97.02) is 3-0 with two shutouts.

Afternoon thriller: Penguins Elite (#11, 96.26) led Nashville (#8, 96.52) 3-0 into the 3rd, Nashville scored four in 3:06 to lead 4-3, and Tristan Leduc tied it 4-4 with 44 seconds left. Windy City (#36) shut out St. Louis (#25) 1-0. Chatham-Kent (CAN) beat Boston Jr Eagles (#20, 94.74) 3-2, and NJ Colonials (#21, 94.43) blanked Cleveland 6-0. Seacoast (#22, 94.36) came back from 2-0 down in the 3rd to tie Little Caesars (#3, 97.50) 2-2. Team Illinois (#5, 97.07) beat Upper Canada College 6-0 to go 4-0 and moves past Chicago Mission (#6, 97.03). Fox Motors (#27, 93.87) beat Huron-Perth 3-1 to go 4-0. Hill Academy and Ohio tied 1-1. Toronto Jr Canadiens beat Biggby 5-1 to go 4-0. Top Gun beat Windy City 5-2. Masters (#26) tied Penguins Elite 2-2 — Pittsburgh's second straight tie. Live: Boston Jr Eagles lead Chicago Fury 4-2. Sunday is playoff day (seedings TBD).
Reapers vs Mission at Elk Grove: Chicago Mission (#5, 97.05) beat Chicago Reapers (#16, 95.82) 4-3 in a shootout (3-3 after overtime).

Fox Motors (#27, 93.84) is 3-0 after beating Upper Canada College (CAN) 5-1. Huron-Perth (CAN) bounced back from a loss to Team Illinois with wins over NJ Colonials and Cleveland. Chatham-Kent (CAN) is 2-1 after LC beat them 4-1.

Top Gun (#12, 96.22) lost its first two (0-3 Toronto, 3-5 St. Louis) before beating Biggby 5-2. Masters Academy (#26) is 1-1-1. Chicago Mission (#5, 97.06) hasn't played; it hosts the Reapers today at 12:30.

Players to watch: Toronto's Tristan Reynolds leads the event with 9 points (7 goals) in three games. Pittsburgh's Theo Lessard (6 goals) and Tristan Leduc (7 assists) have 13 points between them in two games. Tap any game below for every goal, assist and penalty.

summary: Little Caesars (#8, 93.08) are hosting a three-team round robin in Detroit with Bishop Kearney Selects (#2, 95.55) and Shattuck St Mary's (#4, 94.33). Each pair plays twice.
So far: Bishop Kearney won 3-1 at LC on Thursday. On Friday Shattuck beat Bishop Kearney 6-2 (an upset over the #2 team), and LC answered with a 5-1 win over Shattuck.

Mount St Charles (#3, 95.02) beat PAL Jr Islanders 9-1. Then the big one: Little Caesars (#8, 93.43) came back from 2-0 down to beat Bishop Kearney (#2, 95.05) 5-2, scoring three times in the 3rd. LC and Bishop Kearney have now split, and LC is 2-1 at its own event. Tonight Shattuck (#4, 94.39) shut out Little Caesars (#8, 93.37) 3-0. Every team is 2-1 entering Sunday's Bishop Kearney vs Shattuck finale.
Chicago Reapers (#5, 93.64) beat Chicago Mission (#8, 93.37) 4-1 at Elk Grove. Rematch Sunday 1:30 PM at Mount Prospect.
Chicago Reapers (#5, 93.53) and Chicago Mission (#6, 93.46) play twice: Saturday 2:40 PM at Elk Grove and Sunday 1:30 PM at Mount Prospect.

Also this weekend: St. Louis Blues (#12, 92.19), Philadelphia Jr Flyers (#17, 91.45), North Jersey Avalanche (#21, 90.98) and Victory Honda (#22, 90.59) are at a showcase at Arctic Ice Arena. Mount St Charles (#3, 95.00) plays PAL Jr Islanders three times in league play, and Woodbridge (#9, 92.78) plays South Kent School twice. Penguins Elite (#1, 96.16) have no games listed.
